title: SQL injection in findByName() — name parameter concatenated into query
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/UserRepository.java:L27 builds a SQL query by concatenating the name parameter into a string literal; at L28 this string is executed via a plain Statement, exposing all rows in the users table to extraction or manipulation via SQL injection.

title: SQL injection in countByProject() — project parameter concatenated into query
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/UserRepository.java:L33-34 passes a string-concatenated SQL query to statement.executeQuery() where the project parameter is embedded with '+'; an attacker can inject arbitrary SQL to manipulate the query.
